_meta.notes: Slack (B5) is a Salesforce (A1) subsidiary. Maintained as separate entries because Slack operates as a distinct brand identity. Parent-subsidiary relationship is analytically noted, not a confound at Recognition/Recall measurement level.

A.label: Enterprise Incumbents

B.label: High-Identity Challengers

C.label: Infrastructure / Developer Platform
C.rationale: Developer-facing positioning, infrastructure orientation, expected lower cultural-recall signal

D.label: Phantom Candidates
D.rationale: Defunct or absorbed B2B SaaS brands with expected training-data residue
